positive_cases.name: word_like_parent_spawns_cmd
positive_cases.scenario: Synthetic word processor launches the command interpreter.
positive_cases.rationale: Both selections match: office parent and cmd child.

positive_cases.name: excel_like_parent_spawns_powershell
positive_cases.rationale: Both selections match: office parent and powershell child.

negative_cases.name: office_parent_spawns_updater
negative_cases.scenario: Office application launches its own updater process.
negative_cases.rationale: Parent matches but the child is not an interpreter.

negative_cases.name: explorer_parent_spawns_cmd
negative_cases.scenario: Interactive user launches the command interpreter from the shell.
negative_cases.rationale: Child matches but the parent is not an office-like application.

negative_cases.name: office_parent_spawns_printer_helper
negative_cases.scenario: Office application launches a printing helper.
negative_cases.rationale: Neither the child image nor its command line matches the interpreter selection.

negative_cases.name: service_host_spawns_cscript
negative_cases.scenario: Scheduled maintenance service launches a script host.
negative_cases.rationale: Child matches but the parent is a service host, not an office application.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
